{{Quote|I've learned to trust my instincts over the years, and something told me you'd be reliable. Bring this message to Reen Loruk. He needs to be informed of my mission status.|[[Kormund Thrylle]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KT" />}}
'''Reen Loruk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|A message from Kormund? That's good news. We thought he'd been compromised by now.|Reen Loruk, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KT" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Reen Loruk was stationed on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:KT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a Rebel spy named [[Kormund Thrylle]] needed to deliver an urgent message to Loruk. Because it was too dangerous for Thrylle to deliver the message on his own, he tasked a Rebel [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with finding Loruk and giving the message. Fortunately, the spacer found Loruk, just as an Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|Probot]] spotted him. Before the Probot could leave to get reinforcements, it was destroyed by the spacer. Reen Loruk was thankful, and took the message from the spacer. He was surprised, though happy to hear that Thrylle had not yet been compromised by the Empire.<ref name="SWG:KT" />
